name: Spice of Life grants Pooled Vitality from periodic damage (#2219)
contract: Spice of Life 680823 reads 'Your periodic damage and healing now has a $h% chance to grant a stack of Pooled Vitality'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Pooled Vitality 680687, the Bloodmage's registered custom resource (StackAmount 10, TargetA 1). Spell.dbc gives 680823 ProcFlags 0, ProcChance 10, and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and the stack count was identically zero forever. The chance is 10% per tick and the harness has no statistical test, so the scenario must run enough ticks that a false failure is under 0.1%: Taldaram's Torment 800772 ticks every 3 sec, and 66 ticks give 0.9^66 = 0.09% - the scenario therefore waits through about 200 sec of ticking, re-applying the DoT as needed. The proc chance itself is not lowered to make the test deterministic.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Spice of Life passive is active
Pooled Vitality stacks before any tick
DISCRIMINATING: periodic damage eventually grants Pooled Vitality
